title: Add audit log events for residency policy create/update/delete + wire to audit-log-exporter
author: Logan Wright
description: Context: As part of Hosted data residency enforcement we need auditable change history for residency pinning configuration (org/project/api-key level). This PR emits audit log events on residency policy mutations (create/update/delete) and wires those events into the existing audit-log-exporter pipeline so they are available in Console audit log views and customer exports. Scope: Control plane (residency policy service) emits events; exporter normalizes/ships; no changes to request-time enforcement here. Event types (v1): residency_policy.created, residency_policy.updated, residency_policy.deleted, residency_policy.override_applied (admin-only, gated behind flag). Payload highlights: actor (user_id/service, auth_type, ip where available), target (org_id, project_id nullable, api_key_id nullable), policy_id, allowed_regions, primary_region, allow_cross_region_fallback, effective_from, previous_values (for updates, limited), request_id/trace_id for correlation, and metadata (event_version=1, source=control_plane, environment). Security constraints: do NOT include any customer prompt/content; for api_key identifiers we include api_key_id (internal UUID) and last4 only; we do not emit raw key material. For update events, previous_values are limited to residency-related fields only and exclude any free-form notes/description fields. Exporter notes: events are routed to the same destination as other config/audit events; this is metadata-only and allowed per ADR-021 boundaries. Testing: unit tests for event emission on CRUD, exporter schema validation tests, and an integration test that asserts event appears in audit-log-exporter queue with expected fields. Rollout: guarded by feature flag residency_audit_events_v1 (default off); can be enabled per environment. Follow-ups: Console UI will consume these events in DES-611 work; docs to be updated in redwood-docs PR-1189. Checklist: - [x] Emit events on create/update/delete - [x] Add admin override event (flagged) - [x] Add exporter mapping + schema validation - [x] Add tests - [x] Security review sign-off - [x] SRE review for exporter volume impact
